value.summary: Management has demonstrated high credibility by consistently meeting or exceeding revenue and margin targets while maintaining a disciplined approach to guidance. Their ability to deliver strong operational performance despite procedural delays in large-ticket orders like QRSAM underscores their execution capability and robust order pipeline.

promises.quote: around 20% to 25% of the orders we may get before March and remaining orders in Q1 and Q2 of next year.
promises.promised: To receive 20-25% of the NGC (Next Generation Corvette) orders by March 2026, with the rest in H1 FY27.
promises.actual_delivered: The NGC contract was signed by parent PSUs in late 2026, and management expects all line items (approx. Rs 20,000 crore) to be converted to POs by March 2027 as per the Nov 2026 transcript (page 6).
promises.reasoning: The main contract was signed later than initially expected (late 2026 vs early 2026), pushing the sub-system order conversion into late FY27.

promises.quote: we maintain the EBITDA margin of 27% only for the current financial year.
promises.promised: To maintain an EBITDA margin of 27% for FY26.
promises.actual_delivered: The May 2026 transcript (page 3) confirms EBITDA increased to 30% in FY26 compared to 29% in FY25.
promises.reasoning: Management beat their 27% guidance, finishing the year at 30%.

promises.quote: QRSAM itself we are hopeful that we may get by this year itself, by Q4 itself.
promises.promised: To secure the QRSAM order (approx. Rs 30,000 crore) by Q4 FY26.
promises.actual_delivered: As of the Nov 2026 transcript (page 4), the order is still pending CCS approval, though management remains 99% confident of receiving it shortly.
promises.reasoning: The order did not materialize in Q4 FY26 or H1 FY27 due to procedural and CCS approval delays.

promises.quote: we are targeting more than INR1,200 crores as a capital investment for this year.
promises.promised: To invest more than Rs 1,200 crore in Capex during FY27.
promises.actual_delivered: Management reaffirmed this target of Rs 1,200 crore in the Nov 2026 transcript (page 32) as part of their ongoing guidance.
promises.reasoning: The year is still in progress, but management remains committed to the target as of the H1 FY27 update.

guidance.quote: We are working for that revenue growth of 15-plus percent, although there may be some positive surprises
EBITDA margins of around 28%, the order inflow of INR 25,000 crores minimum, excluding QRSAM

guidance.target: Rs 50,000 crore plus including QRSAM for FY27.
guidance.quote: order inflow of INR 25,000 crores minimum, excluding QRSAM and including QRSAM, INR 50,000-plus crores.
R&D investment of INR 2,200-plus crores, capex of around INR 1,200 crores.
And defense to nondefense business, typically 90:10.

bull.point: Strong revenue execution with H1 FY27 growth exceeding 25%.
bull.quote: The revenue from operations increased to INR 12,824 crores up to Q2 as compared to INR 10,180 crores with a growth of 25.97%.

bull.point: Indigenization is driving record gross and EBITDA margins.
bull.quote: It is the indigenization, indigenization of critical technology, indigenization of modules, system, subsystems. That has definitely helped all of us

bear.point: Persistent delays in the mega QRSAM order due to procedural and CCS approvals.
bear.quote: QRSAM, we told we were highly optimistic to get it by March, but procedural delays we knew, that is why we told it may go to Q1/Q2

bear.point: Working capital pressure with rising receivable days.
bear.quote: You are right that receivables have gone up in the current year as compared to last year.

bear.point: Upcoming wage revision in January 2027 may pressure employee costs.
bear.quote: current financial year from January '27 onwards the wage revision is due. So, for the current year, the provisions will be made
